wrap.title: Systems Explored

outro.title: Discovery Complete

bb2.title: Gas Exchange
bb2.prompt: Monitor homeostasis as gases move across membranes.

outro.title: Respiration Restored
outro.p1: The system is stable and oxygenating efficiently.

intro.title: Body Systems: Fuel

bf1.prompt: Match each food to the primary nutrient it provides.

bf3.title: Storage
bf3.prompt: Manage energy reserves for future use.

outro.title: Fueling Complete

intro.title: Space Pack — Solar System
intro.p1: Explore the orbits and connections between celestial bodies.
intro.p2: How do planets, moons, and stars connect across vast distances?

s1.title: Orbits & Periods
s1.prompt: Connect the celestial bodies in their orbital paths. Rotate tiles and open valves to complete the connections.
s1.hint: The Sun connects to Mercury, then Venus, then Earth, then Mars.
s1.solved: Orbital paths connected! The solar system flows.

s2.title: Light & Shadows
s2.prompt: Match each planet to its correct shadow size and shape.
s2.hint: Mercury is the smallest, Earth is medium, Jupiter is the largest.
s2.solved: All planets matched correctly! The shadow puzzle reveals a hidden mechanism.

s3.title: Habitable Clues
s3.prompt: Sort each planet into habitable or non-habitable based on its characteristics.
s3.hint: Earth and Mars are in the habitable zone. Jupiter and Venus are not.
s3.solved: All planets sorted correctly! You understand which worlds could support life.

wrap.title: Space Explored
wrap.done: You've mapped the inner solar system.

outro.title: Space Journey Complete
outro.p1: The solar system's rhythms are now familiar. Each orbit tells a story of gravity and time.

intro.title: Body Systems: Grow
intro.p1: Cells divide and specialize over time.

bg1.title: Mitosis
bg1.prompt: Guide cellular replication for growth and repair.

bg2.title: Differentiation
bg2.prompt: Specialized cells form tissues and organs.

outro.title: Growth Sustained
outro.p1: The system has developed according to its blueprint.

intro.title: Ocean Pack — Deep Blue
intro.p1: Dive into the ocean's layered world — from sunlit shallows to the dark depths.
intro.p2: How do currents, light, and life interconnect beneath the waves?

o1.title: Ocean Layers
o1.prompt: Sort ocean life into the correct depth zones based on where they live.
o1.hint: Sunlit zone (0-200m): coral, plankton. Twilight (200-1000m): lanternfish. Midnight (1000-4000m): anglerfish. Abyss (4000m+): tube worms.

o2.title: Currents & Climate
o2.prompt: Connect the global ocean currents to complete the conveyor belt circulation.
o2.hint: Warm surface currents flow poleward. Cold deep currents flow back toward the equator.
o2.solved: Ocean conveyor belt complete! The global circulation flows.

o3.title: Deep Signals
o3.prompt: Match each marine creature to its unique communication method.
o3.hint: Whales sing, dolphins click, pistol shrimp snap, bioluminescent fish flash.
o3.solved: All creatures matched correctly! You understand how the deep ocean communicates.

wrap.title: Ocean Explored
wrap.done: You've navigated the ocean from surface to abyss.

outro.title: Ocean Journey Complete
outro.p1: The ocean's rhythms are now familiar. From sunlit coral to hadal trenches, every depth tells a story.
